headline: Canadiens’ Oliver Kapanen to make season debut against Sabres
take:
Per Daily Faceoff, Canadiens forward Oliver Kapanen will make his season debut against the Sabres. Defenseman David Reinbacher will also make his debut after being called up from the AHL's Laval Rocket.

The numbers suggest Montreal can use the help. So far this season, MTL has controlled 48.4 percent of expected goals overall, though that figure rises to 55 percent at five-on-five, so the gap comes from special teams and not from the even-strength game. The penalty kill is allowing 0.83 expected goals per game, while the power play is generating 0.45. MTL is also 1.9 goals below expected (3-3-1, 7 points), and its goalies are 2.6 goals saved below expected, which points to finishing and goaltending more than process. Buffalo looks similar on paper at 52.1 percent of expected goals overall and 55 percent at five-on-five, and BUF is 5.7 goals saved below expected. Both teams are playing better than their results, so this one may hinge on which goalie stops the shots he should. Two small samples, but Reinbacher and Kapanen's lines are worth watching for any lift at five-on-five.
